Lina (CSM): Flagging NovaCorp dedicated bring-up. Go-live Fri. Need final quota rows, autoscale rules, and loadtest cadence. Renewal touchpoint same week so T+72h health checks required.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Understood. What steady/peak targets should I simulate for gen endpoints?
Priya (SRE): Plan baseline 180 qps, steady 300 qps, burst 700 qps for short windows. Suggest three-phase tests: smoke (5m), ramp (20m), soak (45m).
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll prep scripts and a 24h warmup to populate KV/prefix caches.
Kai (Support): I'm on-call Friday; share alert thresholds and playbook please. I'll stand up a dedicated huddle if alerts fire.
Priya (SRE): Alerts: error_rate > 1% for 60s, p95 > 600ms for 2m, p99 > 1200ms pager. Fallback to smaller-model pool if p95 > 800ms.
Nora (Product): Can we expose a per-route circuit-breaker flag to throttle premium routes during soak if token costs spike? Also add a one-question feedback card in the enablement deck.
Lina (CSM): Will notify renewal owner and mark "high-touch" for 14 days post go-live.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Load command I'll run:

```
./stressgen --target https://api.redwood.private/nova --rps 300 --duration 45m --pattern ramp --headers "x-account:nova"
```

Diego (Solutions Eng): KV priming command:

```
python tools/kv_seed.py --account nova --file nova_prompts.json --concurrency 8
```

Priya (SRE): Draft autoscale policy:

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 14
  scale_by: p95_latency_ms
  target: 420
  evaluation_period_sec: 60
  cool_down_sec: 90
```

Kai (Support): I'll publish the support runbook + CSAT survey and pin links here. I'll monitor error logs, fallback triggers, and token-cost dashboards.
ci-bot: CI green for nova/onboard - build #4821 at 2024-07-18T10:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
Diego (Solutions Eng): Proposed windows:
- Thu 02:00 UTC: KV warmup (10m)
- Thu 03:00 UTC: smoke (5m)
- Thu 03:30 UTC: ramp (20m)
- Fri 01:00 UTC: soak (45m) + go-live verification
Lina (CSM): Ops approved. Action items:
1) Priya: commit autoscale policy + add runbook link.
2) Diego: upload load scripts + metrics artifacts to shared drive.
3) Kai: publish support playbook + wire CSAT.
4) Lina: send renewal note + enablement deck + pre-mortem.
Ping here when items are complete. :thumbsup:
